children: DraftKings has been using artificial intelligence to code faster and using machine learning to serve customers with content and products that relevant to them, CEO Jason Robins says at the NEXTPredict summit in New York. The CEO is pushing back on reporting that DraftKings is using AI to target gamblers who are the most likely to lose. "The degree to which AI is used is overblown," according to Robins. "People are generally fearful of it," he says. (dean.seal@wsj.com)
